issues.description: The template defines the distillation builder function as build_msd_circuit but the problem statement and the solution use the name build_msd_circ. This name mismatch is structural (not a missing implementation) and will confuse students and break tests that expect the function name from the spec.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the function name consistent across artifacts. Either rename the template function build_msd_circuit to build_msd_circ to match the problem statement and solution, or update the problem statement/tests and the solution to use build_msd_circuit. Ensure all references (docstrings, tests, and other code) use the same name.

issues.description: The problem statement and the solution implement/expect a function named build_msd_circ(...), but the template defines the function as build_msd_circuit(...). This inconsistent identifier for the same conceptual routine (building the magic-state distillation circuit) can confuse students and cause tests or scaffolding code to fail to locate the intended function.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function build_msd_circuit(...) to build_msd_circ(...) to match the problem statement and solution (or alternatively update the problem/tests and solution to use build_msd_circuit consistently). Ensure the function signature and documentation remain unchanged while fixing the identifier.
